notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.content:
We've been working on this game for two years, and this is the first time we're releasing a major demo like this.

Take a look around and try to solve the puzzles in this approximately 45-minute-long demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049721/6a8f7e03ba470975316ab705fe1a2c27299e71c9.gif[/img]

[h2]There's even more to do[/h2]
[list] [*] For the completionists among you, we've added Golden Guns that you can collect. These fire off achievements for the demo.
[*] There is a speedrun challenge coming soon (with prizes!). We'll post updates here and on our Discord!
[*] We're hosting a creativity contest soon; there is a secret room at the end of the first chamber where you can paint color onto a 16x16 wall. The best artwork will win prizes; we'll post more details about this here as well! [/list]
It would be fantastic if you'd leave us a review for the demo—that would mean a lot to us.

If you're stuck somewhere, feel free to post in the forum here on Steam or on our [url=https://discord.gg/pixel-maniacs]Discord[/url].

[h2]Thanks to our playtesters[/h2]

Thanks a lot to our hundreds of playtesters who checked out the first early versions of the game, giving us valuable feedback about all aspects of the game.

We got very important insights about e.g. the colorblind mode we've implemented into the demo, here's an overview about the feedback you gave us:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049721/01d7aa58649d95ece2f22e55f90a1a9bd3253769.gif[/img]
